howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.sub: One account works across Kriraghor. Here is what happens in each part, and how your money is kept safe.

s1.title: Verify your game UID
s1.body: Add your UID with a profile screenshot. One UID per game.

s2.title: Pay the entry fee
s2.body: bKash, Nagad or card. Held safely until results are final.

s3.title: Check in, get the room
s3.body: The room ID and password appear for you before the match.

s4.title: Win and withdraw
s4.body: Prizes land in your balance. Withdraw to bKash or Nagad.

gym.title: Gym
gym.owners: members, fees, check-ins, reminders and reports, all on gym.kriraghor.com.

s1.title: Find a gym
s1.body: Compare gyms near you by area, price and facilities.

s2.title: Buy a pass or ask to join
s2.body: Buy a pass online, or send a join request and the gym confirms your package.

s3.title: Show your QR
s3.body: Show your code at the front desk to get in. A verified phone is enough, no NID needed.

s4.title: Follow your plan
s4.body: See your dues, attendance, workout plans and diet charts from your gym in one place.

venues.title: Venues
venues.owners: list your venue, set your prices and hours, and get paid at check-in.

s1.title: Pick a venue and a time
s1.body: See open hours by sport and area, then choose your slot.

s2.title: Pay online
s2.body: Pay the full amount, or just the advance the venue asks for, with bKash, Nagad or card.

s3.title: Check in and play
s3.body: Check in at the venue and pay any balance there. The venue gets its money at check-in.

s4.title: If plans change
s4.body: The advance isn't refunded if you cancel or don't show up. If the venue cancels, you get everything back.

shop.title: Shop
shop.owners: open a verified shop with your own page, stock, orders and payouts.

s1.title: Find your gear
s1.body: Browse sports gear, gym gear and supplements from verified shops.

s2.title: Pay online
s2.body: Pay with bKash, Nagad or card. Kriraghor holds the money until your order is delivered.

s3.title: Get your order
s3.body: Follow your order in your account. If something is wrong, report it and the money stays held.

s4.title: Supplements
s4.body: Expired stock can't be sold, and opened items can't be returned.

s1.title: Find the right person
s1.body: Umpires, referees, coaches and players, with ratings and rates on each profile.

s2.title: Talk in the app
s2.body: Send a request and agree the job. Phone numbers stay hidden until you pay.

s3.title: Pay through Kriraghor
s3.body: Your money is held safely until the job is done.

s4.title: Confirm the job
s4.body: The pro marks the job complete and you confirm. If you don't respond in time and no dispute is open, the money is released.

events.title: Sports tournaments
events.owners: run your club or league's tournament, with registrations, fixtures and results.

s1.title: Find a tournament
s1.body: See which sports tournaments are open for teams, and their dates and fees.

s2.title: Register your team
s2.body: A captain enters the team with its squad and pays the entry fee online.

s3.title: Play your matches
s3.body: Fixtures, results and standings are on the tournament page.

money.title: Money held safely
money.body: Entry fees, bookings, orders and hires are held by Kriraghor until you get what you paid for.

verified.title: Verified people
verified.body: Phone-verified players, NID-verified sellers, and owners and officials checked by our staff.

refunds.title: Clear refunds
refunds.body: Tournaments that don't fill and bookings the owner cancels are refunded in full.
